channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Nvidia's board said on Sunday it has opened an independent investigation, overseen by independent directors and outside counsel, after reports that Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort; the board says it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, and CNBC reported the stock down about 5% on Monday while AMD and other chipmakers rose. The buyers did not blink. Riot's 10-Q names Anthropic as the tenant on a 15-year, 910 MW powered land lease for its whole Corsicana, Texas campus at $130 per kW-month, about $28 billion of contract value, and the FT reports Anthropic paid about $3.4 billion for 1.7 GW of gas-fired generators. Microsoft is moving the other way on rented capacity, winding down a 2023 Oracle deal on older Nvidia hardware a day after Bloomberg reported tighter oversight of its neocloud projects; CoreWeave reports Q3 on Tuesday with its 2032 notes yielding above 16%. Live list prices held: 70 confirms, 0 ticks and 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69 after Friday's rise.

item.title: Compute brief - 9 November 2026
item.description: Nvidia's board said on Sunday it has opened an independent investigation, overseen by independent directors and outside counsel, after reports that Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort; the board says it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, and CNBC reported the stock down about 5% on Monday while AMD and other chipmakers rose. The buyers did not blink. Riot's 10-Q names Anthropic as the tenant on a 15-year, 910 MW powered land lease for its whole Corsicana, Texas campus at $130 per kW-month, about $28 billion of contract value, and the FT reports Anthropic paid about $3.4 billion for 1.7 GW of gas-fired generators. Microsoft is moving the other way on rented capacity, winding down a 2023 Oracle deal on older Nvidia hardware a day after Bloomberg reported tighter oversight of its neocloud projects; CoreWeave reports Q3 on Tuesday with its 2032 notes yielding above 16%. Live list prices held: 70 confirms, 0 ticks and 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69 after Friday's rise. Countries: United States: Riot leases its whole 910 MW Corsicana, Texas campus to Anthropic for about $28 billion over 15 years; first 400 MW by September 2027 (Wire, 4 Nov, confirmed). United States: Anthropic buys commitments for 1.7 GW of gas-fired generators from OnePWR for about $3.4 billion (Wire, 8 Nov, FT single-source). United States: SpaceXAI files for a 747-acre, up to 6 GW campus in Cochise County, Arizona; zoning decision 9 December (Wire, 6 Nov). Malaysia: SoftBank, Grab and PETROS commit $1.85 billion of staged seed capital toward 5 GW or more of AI capacity in Sarawak and Peninsular Malaysia (Wire, 9 Nov). China: About 600,000 H200s held in Hong Kong as Beijing withholds large-scale import approval (Wire, 5 Nov, Reuters single-source). Israel: National AI Directorate targets about 300,000 GPUs and 2 GW for a sovereign AI stack (Wire, 9 Nov, single-source). Kazakhstan: Preliminary deals add 480 MW at Ekibastuz Data Center Valley; 1 GW target by 2029 (Wire, 6 Nov, single-source).
